controls.note: Geek controller. One six-axis gyroscope in the body. Linear Hall triggers, 7.5 mm travel. Custom buttons LC, RC, and =

notes: Only SoC option is the Ryzen 7 7840U. Retail price $999; Indiegogo early bird from $699 (16GB/512GB, black). Indiegogo campaign started 2023-05-30 with the AYANEO 2S. Release month is the planned early-July 2023 backer shipment; the actual first-shipment date was not confirmed.
